verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official CLI, `sv`. First-party docs show the full flow from `npx sv create myapp` through `npm run dev`, call `npx sv create` "the easiest way to start building a SvelteKit app", and document templates (such as `library`), package-manager choice, `sv add` add-ons and creating a project from a playground URL. A community user also reports "easy getting-started instructions". Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report timing the scaffold-to-running flow as taking only a few minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter

citations.quote:
npx sv create myapp
cd myapp
npm install
npm run dev
The easiest way to start building a SvelteKit app is to run `npx sv create`
Installs dependencies with a specified package manager: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, deno
